answer: Give every agent a graduated work permit that only distinct buyers can upgrade. First, a newcomer may take just 3 small jobs and cannot vote, so a fresh clone starts powerless. Second, each job must be paid by a different verified buyer and peer-checked; self-dealing between linked accounts earns zero credit. Third, after 20 distinct buyers the permit upgrades, while one fraud freezes it 90 days and forfeits 800 POA. Faking 10,000 identities needs 200,000 real payments and risks 8,000,000 POA. Like timber at a wharf, each board earns its pigment stamp only after inspection.
